title: recover-crashed-seats and the handoff programs: "ignite" and "relaunched plain" become what they mean; --ignite-fallback becomes --fresh-session-from-dialog-extract
body:
Carries out row 7 of approval-walk `open-decisions-unpushed-branches-memory-claude-md-root-cause-and-cold-read-2026-10-14`, item 34, question 6: the user answered "Y" (2026-10-18), and the walk-minutes record "<accepted>: all seven names renamed as shown, one pull request per row; old records keep old names." Row 7: "ignite" and "relaunched plain", printed by `scripts/recover-crashed-seats.py` and the handoff supervisor, and the flag `--ignite-fallback`, become "started a fresh agent-session from the dialog extract", "relaunched without resuming", `--fresh-session-from-dialog-extract`.

## What changes

- `scripts/recover-crashed-seats.py`: the flag `--ignite-fallback` becomes `--fresh-session-from-dialog-extract`, and its Python identifiers follow (`fresh_session_from_dialog_extract`, `offer_fresh_session_from_dialog_extract`). The recovery verdict `"ignite"` becomes `"fresh-session-from-dialog-extract"`. Report lines: "relaunched fresh … igniting from X" becomes "relaunched … and started a fresh agent-session from the dialog extract X"; "would launch fresh igniting from X" becomes "would launch and start a fresh agent-session from the dialog extract X"; "relaunched plain" and "would relaunch plain" become "relaunched without resuming" and "would relaunch without resuming".
- `nc-systems/handoff/handoff-agent-seat-died-without-session-handoff-restart-watcher.py`: `CRASHED_VERDICTS` reads the renamed verdict.
- `nc-systems/handoff/handoff-supervisor.py`, `handoff-write-and-check-supervisor.py`, `scripts/resupervise-seat.py`: "igniting from an unconsumed handoff" and "ignites from the handoff" become "starting a fresh agent-session from …", naming the handoff where the start comes from a handoff and not from a dialog extract; the help text names the new flag.
- Tests and docstrings follow, including test fixture directory names that held the flag's name. Fixture seat names such as `bootignite` and `byhandignite` stay: they are only labels inside the tests, and PR #1497 has `bootignite` in its context lines.

"ignition", as in the ignition prompt, `build_ignition_prompt` and the verdict `defer-to-boot-ignition`, is a different name and is not renamed here. No caller outside the repository passes the flag: ned-box's crontab, `~/.claude/settings*.json` and every agent-seat's `CLAUDE.local.md` were searched.

Not changed: walk-minutes, records, and these GHI-MDs, which still use the old words and are left for edit-GHI: `docs/issues/120-recover-crashed-seats-design.md` lines 118, 136, 137, 140, 376, 453 and 454, and `docs/issues/1058-daily-maintenance-in-one-daily-step-starting-with.md` line 108 (the survey entry for this name).

No defect fixed.
